explanation: Faithfully states the BBMST24 upper bound I(k) ≤ exp((c + o(1)) k^{3/2}/(log k)^{1/2}), with c = 4√τ/3 and τ = Σ_{t≥1} log²((t+1)/t). The reindexed tsum (t+2)/(t+1) over t ≥ 0 is the same sum. The o(1) is encoded via an arbitrary ε. The reduction from minimal covering systems is correct, since distinct irreducible sets give distinct systems.
